_comment: DXB-DEL-068 H6/H7 example provider-config for the official DeepSeek Harness ACP provider. Install at $XDG_STATE_HOME/dxbot/runtime/provider-config.json with mode 0600. This file stores ONLY an env: credential reference; never place the MINIMAX_API_KEY value here. All harness paths are absolute and validated; DSH_HOME is a dedicated isolated directory (owner-only 0700, never a symlink, never the ambient user DSH home). The command must be a direct regular file, owner-executable, and not group/other-writable. The patch must be a direct regular file (not a symlink) and not group/other-writable.
_source_identity: The harness is pinned to the exact upstream identity recorded in DXB-DEL-064: commit cd5ef8148158c3a752a658978873241fdf8e2bbc, tag dsh-v0.1.2-alpha.1, root package version 0.1.2-alpha.1. source_commit and source_version below must be these exact values or composition fails closed.
_digests: command_sha256 and patch_sha256 are lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 digests. Replace the placeholder command_sha256 below with the digest of your pinned dsh executable: run 'sha256sum /usr/lib/dxbot/dsh/bin/dsh'. patch_sha256 must be the digest of the audited deploy/dsh/dsh-acp.patch.yaml you ship; run 'sha256sum deploy/dsh/dsh-acp.patch.yaml' and use that value. The Runtime independently recomputes both from disk and additionally requires the on-disk patch to match the compile-time audited digest of the repository patch; a mismatch fails closed before any secret is resolved.
